sights.address: Tomari, Naha, Okinawa (north shore of Tomari Port)
sights.w: A small walled cemetery on the north bank of Tomari Port holding about 22 foreigners from the 18th to early 20th centuries and some 300 post-war burials, with a monument to Commodore Perry's 1853 landing. Its oldest Western grave, of the British sailor 'WM HARES', is dated 1816.
sights.k: Historic foreigners' cemetery & Perry landing monument

sights.n: Naminoue Beach & Naminoue Umisora Park (波の上ビーチ・波の上うみそら公園)
sights.w: Naha's only city beach, sitting below the cliff-top Naminoue Shrine, with free entry and swimming from mid-April to October. The adjoining Umisora Park's enclosed man-made bay is a favourite with people learning to dive.
